title: 序章第1章 药剂学菜鸟第2章 魔法天才
content_zh:
清晨上线之后，林立依旧是循例先登入法师小号。
周日的明月城总是特别热闹，川流不息的玩家比起往常多了不止一倍，就连收费昂贵的私人仓库里，此时也是被挤了个水泄不通。
“麻烦帮我把……”林立好不容易挤到索兰面前，正打算让这位美女管理员帮他取出邮寄物品。
谁知道一句话还没说完，就被人从背后推了一把。
“你看清楚外面的字没有？这里是私人仓库，你一个小号跑来凑什么热闹？”说话的是个四十来级的战士，身后跟着四五名玩家，看上去似乎是某个小团体的头头。
战士开了口，身后那几名玩家也相继表达了自己的不满：“这小号有毛病是吧，没事跑到私人仓库来挤什么挤？”
“谁知道，估计人家以为这里的都是有钱人，想来讨点钱买药升级呢。”
“要钱怎么不去拍卖行？那里可都是财主，要是碰上谁心情好，扔你几十金币，你这升级的药钱可就不用发愁了。”
林立只是看了这些苍蝇一眼，然后又耐着性子挤到索兰面前：“麻烦帮我把昨天邮寄的物品都取出来。”
“好的，麻烦您稍等一下。
然后这一群围观群众就看见，各种各样的矿锭从私人仓库里被放出来，有常见的秘银瑟银，也有罕见的精金魔铁，魔法金属特有的光泽在私人仓库内闪动着耀眼的光彩，晃花了所有玩家的眼睛，刚刚此起彼伏的声音刹时间静了下来，整个私人仓库里就只听吞口水的声音……
众人的目光还没来得及从大量矿锭上移开，美女管理员又从仓库里拿出了一堆东西，那是上百张被码得整整齐齐的黑龙皮，细密的龙鳞在魔法金属的光泽下反射出动人心魄的光亮，这可是真正的黑龙皮，魔法防御物理防御的完美结合体，用它们制作出来的装备，每一件都至少是传说级别，这上百块黑龙皮，几乎就意味着上百件传至少传说级别的装备！
而且这还没完，上百张黑龙皮之下，是二十几块已经冶炼好的神之金属。
二十几块神之金属刚一现身，整个私人仓库就顿时沸腾了。
“你们快看，那东西好象是传说中的神之金属啊！”
“什么好象，那根本就是神之金属，我的天！整整二十几块，这小法师是不是刚刚打劫过一头龙？”这家伙倒是猜对了一半，林立确实刚扫荡过一处龙穴，只不过在扫荡龙穴的同时，他还顺手干掉了毁灭之龙阿扎达斯而已。
在场众人中不乏锻造专业的玩家，神之金属的价值他们是再清楚不过了。
用神之金属锻造的装备也许在一开始的时候，属性并不如何突出，但随着使用的时间越长，使用者的等级渐渐提高，神之金属可怕的成长特性就会慢慢展露出来，官方论坛上有很多锻造专业的高手曾经预言过，如果一个玩家从一级就开始使用神之金属锻造的装备，那么等他升到七十级的时候，这件装备就算不是神器，也至少可以达到史诗级别！
而且这禽兽还一拿就是二十几块，这还给不给人活路走了？
众人就这么眼睁睁的，看着林立将二十块神之金属扫进背包，那眼神简直就象是看到自己老婆跟别的男人进了宾馆……

等到索兰又从仓库里拿出一张卷轴的时候，众人望过去的目光已经有些呆滞了，一个能随手拿出两件史诗级装备，外加上百块龙皮二十几块神之金属的禽兽，又有什么事情是干不出来的？
但等到那张卷轴被交到林立手上时，众人依然是立刻就崩溃掉了。
“愿望术！那是愿望术卷轴！”卷轴刚一过手，就有识货的玩家叫了出来。
“这怎么可能！你是不是看错了?”
“真的，那真的是愿望术卷轴！”
这张卷轴的出现，让刚刚安静了几分钟的私人仓库又沸腾了起来。
这已经不是财大气粗所能形容的了，一张愿望术卷轴，意味着拥有者可以向系统主神许下一个愿望，只要在游戏规则之内，任何愿望都可以实现。这个愿望可以是无穷无尽的财富，可以是某件强大无比的装备，也可以让系统主神帮你杀死某个神话级生物，甚至可以是一块富源辽阔的土地，让你在上面建立自己的王国。
此时众人望向林立的目光中，已经多多少少带着点别的意思了。
不过林立一点也没把他们放在心上，伸出两根手指，轻轻夹出愿望术卷轴往背包里一放，就这么招摇过市的出了私人仓库。
林立沿着运河一路往贸易区走去，身后却多了数十条各怀鬼胎的尾巴。
“还真跟来了……”林立回头望了一眼，不由得乐了，杀人越货也不看看人来，你们最好跟得紧一些，等老子忙完手上的正事，少不了要换猎人号上来跟你们好好谈谈。
事实上林立的猎人号，此时就停在明月城拍卖行内，那可是手持神话武器星辰之怒的超级猎人，法师不过是仓库小号而已。只不过也不知道是不是因为林立运气太好，当初只打算用来当仓库才建的法师小号，却神奇的分到了智力精神双满的极品属性，以至于后来林立总是很烦恼，这么极品的小号，究竟该用来干点什么才好……
最后想想这么极品的小号可不能浪费，于是林立干脆让小号练起各种生活职业来，这家伙也是狠人一个，不练就不练，一练就全练，只要能够学习的生活技能，他是一样也没落下，如今一个一级小号，却已经将锻造，炼金，药剂，附魔，铭文五大技能练到了高级，就连药物知识，矿物知识，烹饪手艺，卷轴制作等等一系列杂学，也统统升到了高级以上。
不紧不慢的走到贸易区，林立在铁匠铺门口停下了脚步。
上百块秘银哗啦哗啦的被倒进熔炉，林立站在旁边稍等了两分钟，也不管秘银是否融化，夹出一块就放到铁砧上猛敲，身后数十玩家只见一阵火花四溅，价值数百金币的秘银瞬间被敲成一块废铁。
高级铁匠用秘银锻造，敲成废铁那是理所当然的事，不过是不是敲成废铁对林立来说其实都没什么区别，他不缺那几百金币，也不缺那几块秘银，事实上在闪光平原千针石林等很多地方，他都拥有自己的私人矿脉，只是没人知道罢了……
敲废几块秘银算得了什么，只要技能点数涨上去就行了。
在一众铁匠吐血的表情中，林立又忙碌开了，一块接着一块，足足花了大半个小时，才将上百块秘银彻底报废，而锻造技能自然也是一路突飞猛进。
秘银之后是瑟银，瑟银之后是魔铁，魔铁之后是精金……
当价值不下百万的矿石敲成废铁之后，那悦耳的系统提示音终于传来：“恭喜您晋阶锻造大师！”

揉了揉酸疼的手臂，林立回头望了一眼满面呆滞的围观群众，这才收拾起工具，转身往药剂店方向走去。
又是上百万金币的药草砸下去，药剂学也顺利升到了大师级别。
跟着是炼金学……
再跟着是附魔……
最后是铭文……
等到林立将五种技能全部升到大师级别的时候，已经差不多到中午了，一群尾随而来的玩家就这么目瞪口呆的看着他糟蹋材料，刚开始的时候还会替他心疼一下，到了最后简直就彻底麻木了，围观群众们甚至已经开始猜测，这家伙会不会是某个富家公子哥，因为在现实里受了什么刺激，才跑到游戏里来发泄的。
顺利将五项技能升到大师级别，林立终于是停下来歇了口气，正当所有人都以为他要收手的时候，林立却从背包里拿出了愿望术卷轴。
“这家伙想干什么？”愿望术卷轴的威力实在太过恐怖，林立这才刚一拿出来，身后几名玩家就如临大敌的做好了戒备，毕竟这家伙看起来就不象正常人，手里又拿着愿望术卷轴这种变态东西，万一他一个想不开，许愿让系统主神来一场大屠杀什么的，自己站在这里岂不是自寻死路？
“你们还真看得起自己……”林立瞟了一眼那几个如临大敌的玩家，心想老子吃饱了撑的才会拿许愿术卷轴来对付你们，也不称称自己几斤几两，你们值这个价钱吗？
随着许愿术卷轴被轻轻展开，明月城的上空忽然挂起了一道彩虹，七彩斑斓的光芒柔柔洒下，让整个明月城看上去就仿佛被梦境笼罩一般，庄严神圣的颂唱声中，一阵威严的声音传来，仿佛远在天边，却又仿佛近在身旁。
“你有什么愿望？”
林立望着天空中的彩虹，微微犹豫了一下，这才深深的吸了口气：“我的愿望是提升我所有的生活技能水平！”
就在愿望许下的瞬间，天空中的彩虹也随之化做无数光亮，只见那星星点点的光亮从天空中缓缓落下，就仿佛一条七色丝带般将林立包裹在内，林立可以清晰的感受到，随着自己的每一次呼吸，都仿佛有无数光亮融入体内，当最后一丝光亮也被彻底吸收之时，脑海内却随之涌出无穷无尽的知识，有锻造学的，有炼金学的，有药剂学的，也有附魔和铭文的，甚至还包括了药物知识，矿物知识等等杂学，这些知识就仿佛与生俱来就拥有一般，刚一涌出，就与原有记忆融合到了一起，林立只需要信手拈来就能轻易运用。
林立查看了一下自己的技能状态，四种主要技能果然已经达到宗师级别，而各种杂学也多在大师级别以上，想想无尽世界开放一年多来，别说一个五系宗师，就连找一个单系大师恐怕都很难。
生活技能可不是个人等级所能比的，个人等级只要你有足够的时间，不断的杀死怪物，不断的完成任务，就可以累积足够的经验升级。但生活技能到了高级之后，想进一步那真的是千难万难，也只有林立这种财大气粗的角色，才想得出用高级材料来砸技能的办法，想想今天五项技能，就花了差不多五百万金币，除了刚刚扫荡过龙穴的林立，又有谁能承受得起？
而大师级别更象一道分水岭，当技能达到大师级别之后，就不再是用钱能够解决的问题了，也许一万次成功的锻造，也不会让你的技能提升哪怕一点，而一次失败的锻造，却有可能让你的技能突飞猛进，没人敢说，自己有一天一定会达到宗师级别，哪怕是他离宗师已经只有一步之遥。
当然相应的，宗师与大师相比，也是一个天上一个地下。
大师级技能最多只能制作传说物品，而且一千次里还不一定能成功一次，而宗师级技能不但可以随意的制作传说物品，还能够轻易的制作出史诗物品，虽然仍然有一定的失败几率，但是比起大师级来，简直不可同日而语。
至于神话物品，那已经不是凡人所能想象的了，能够制作神器的人，不管他是什么职业，称号都永远只有一个，那就是——神匠！
愿望术卷轴是个好东西，利用它获得一笔数千万的财富，或者是杀死某个神话级生物，甚至是建立自己的王国，这无疑是一个不错的选择，但林立始终觉得，利用它成为一名全职业宗师，这才是最明智的选择。

林立望了一眼天空中消散的彩虹，慢慢将锻炼技能所余下的材料收进背包，亲眼目睹了神迹之后，那数十名围观玩家早就没有了杀人越货的念头，满面呆滞的看着林立收拾材料，却是谁也不敢动上一动。
一个能够随手拿出无数极品材料，敲敲铁锤摇摇药瓶就是上百万金币砸出去的人，又岂是他们能够招惹得起的？别的不说，随便拿个几十万金币出来，就够雇人把他们杀得删号了，杀人越货？自杀还差不多……
将所有材料收进背包，林立正打算下线换号，用猎人来跟围观群众好好谈谈时，一阵尖锐的警报声却忽然响起。
“系统发生未知故障，请所有在线玩家立刻下线！”
“系统发生未知故障，请所有在线玩家立刻下线！”
“系统发生未知故障，请所有在线玩家立刻下线！”
警报一连响了三遍，林立刚要抽身下线，却忽然发现自己的人物已经不受控制。
还没等他明白过来是怎么回事，这种无法控制的感觉就已经蔓延到了他现实中的身体，那种感觉就仿佛灵魂与肉体剥离一般，明明可以看见自己，却又无法感受到自己的存在，四周的一切都好象变得软绵绵的，任凭林立如何挣扎，也无法摆脱那种令人绝望的无力感。
林立渐渐感到，自己的一缕意识正轻飘飘的往上浮去，他甚至可以看到另一个自己正软软的躺在椅子上，惊骇之下林立猛的抬起头来，头顶竟是漆黑一片，那是真正的黑暗，没有任何一丝杂质搀杂其中，哪怕是一丝光亮投去，也会一点不深的被吸引那无尽的黑暗当中……
“谁这么下流，居然在我家里藏了个黑洞！”在最后一丝意识被黑暗吞噬前，林立心头冒出的居然是这么个疑问……
content_en:
After going online in the morning, Lin Li logged into the mage's account first as usual.
Mingyue City is always very lively on Sundays, with more than twice as many players as usual. Even the expensive private warehouses are packed to the brim at this time.
"Please help me..." Lin Li finally squeezed in front of Solan and was about to ask the beautiful administrator to help him take out the mailed items.
Who knew that before he could finish a sentence, someone pushed him from behind.
"Did you read clearly what's written outside? This is a private warehouse. Why are you here to join in the fun with a small account?" The speaker was a warrior in his forties, followed by four or five players. He seemed to be the leader of a small group.
The warrior spoke, and the players behind him also expressed their dissatisfaction: "There is something wrong with this trumpet, right? Why would you come to the private warehouse to squeeze in when you have nothing to do?"
"Who knows, maybe people think that the people here are all rich people who want to come here to ask for some money to buy medicines and upgrades."
"Why don't you go to the auction house if you want money? There are rich people there. If you meet someone in a good mood and throw you dozens of gold coins, you don't have to worry about the money for the upgraded medicine."
Lin Li just glanced at the flies, and then patiently squeezed in front of Solan: "Please help me take out all the items mailed yesterday."
"Okay, please wait a moment.
Then the group of onlookers saw various mineral ingots being released from the private warehouse, including common mithril, thorium, and rare adamantine and magic iron. The unique luster of magic metal flashed dazzlingly in the private warehouse, dazzling the eyes of all players. The sounds that had just been coming and going fell silent for an instant, and the entire private warehouse could only hear the sound of swallowing saliva...
Before everyone could look away from the large number of mineral ingots, the beautiful administrator took out a bunch of things from the warehouse. They were hundreds of neatly arranged black dragon skins. The fine dragon scales reflected the soul-stirring light under the luster of magic metal. This was real black dragon skin, a perfect combination of magic and physical defense. Every piece of equipment made with them was at least legendary level. These hundreds of black dragon skins almost meant hundreds of pieces of equipment that were said to be at least legendary level!
And this is not over yet. Under the hundreds of black dragon skins, there are more than twenty pieces of God's metal that have been smelted.
As soon as more than twenty pieces of God's Metal appeared, the entire private warehouse immediately boiled.
"Look, that thing seems to be the legendary metal of God! "
"What does it look like? It is simply the metal of God, my God! A total of more than twenty yuan. Did this little mage just rob a dragon? "This guy was half right. Lin Li had indeed just swept a dragon's lair, but while sweeping the dragon's lair, he also killed Azadas, the Dragon of Destruction.
There were many professional forging players among the people present, and they knew the value of God's metal very well.
Equipment forged with God's Metal may not have outstanding attributes at the beginning, but as the user's level gradually increases with use, the terrifying growth characteristics of God's Metal will slowly be revealed. Many blacksmithing experts on the official forum have predicted that if a player starts using equipment forged from God's Metal from level one, then by the time he reaches level 70, even if this piece of equipment is not an artifact, it will at least reach an epic level!
Moreover, this beast is worth more than twenty yuan at a time. Is this going to give people a way to survive?
Everyone just watched helplessly as Lin Li swept twenty pieces of God's Metal into his backpack. Their eyes were as if they saw their wife entering a hotel with another man...
When Solan took out another scroll from the warehouse, everyone's eyes were already a little dull. One person could easily take out two pieces of epic equipment, plus a hundred pieces of dragon skin.What can't a beast with more than a dozen pieces of god's metal do?
But when the scroll was handed over to Lin Li, everyone still collapsed immediately.
"Wish spell! That's the wish spell scroll!" As soon as the scroll was handed over, a knowledgeable player shouted out.
"How is this possible! Did you see it wrong?"
"Really, that's really a wish scroll!"
The appearance of this scroll caused the private warehouse that had been quiet for a few minutes to boil again.
This is no longer something that can be described by wealth. A wish scroll means that the owner can make a wish to the main god of the system. As long as it is within the rules of the game, any wish can be realized. This wish can be endless wealth, a piece of extremely powerful equipment, or the system god can help you kill a mythical creature, or it can even be a rich and vast land on which you can build your own kingdom.
At this time, everyone looked at Lin Li with something else in their eyes.
However, Lin Li didn't take them to heart at all. He stretched out two fingers, gently took out the wish scroll, put it in his backpack, and then left the private warehouse in a swaggering manner.
Lin Li walked along the canal toward the trade area, but behind him were dozens of tails with different agendas.
"I'm really following..." Lin Li looked back and couldn't help but feel happy. He killed people and stole goods without looking at anyone. You'd better follow closely. When I finish the business at hand, I will inevitably switch to the Hunter to come up and have a good talk with you.
In fact, Lin Li's hunter was parked in the Auction House of Mingyue City at this time. He was a super hunter holding the mythical weapon Wrath of the Stars. The mage was just a warehouse trumpet. But I don’t know if it was because Lin Li was so lucky. The mage trumpet he built with the intention of being used as a warehouse was magically endowed with the best attributes of both intelligence and spirit. So Lin Li was always worried about what he should use such a best trumpet for...
Finally, he thought that such a top-quality trumpet should not be wasted, so Lin Li simply let the trumpet practice various life occupations. This guy is also a ruthless person.
Lin Li walked leisurely to the trading area and stopped at the door of the blacksmith shop.
Hundreds of pieces of mithril were poured into the furnace. Lin Li stood aside and waited for two minutes. Regardless of whether the mithril melted or not, he picked out a piece and put it on the anvil and struck it hard. Dozens of players behind him saw a burst of sparks flying, and the mithril worth hundreds of gold coins was instantly knocked into a piece of scrap metal.
It is a matter of course that senior blacksmiths use mithril to forge and hammer it into scrap iron. However, it does not make any difference to Lin Li whether it is hammered into scrap iron or not. He does not lack the hundreds of gold coins or the few pieces of mithril. In fact, he has his own private mineral veins in many places such as the Thousand Needles Stone Forest in the Shining Plains, but no one knows about it...
It doesn't matter if you destroy a few pieces of mithril, as long as the skill points increase.

After mithril comes thorium, after thorium comes magic iron, after magic iron comes adamantine...

Then comes alchemy…
Next comes the enchantment...
Finally, there is the inscription...
By the time Lin Li upgraded all five skills to the master level, it was almost noon. A group of players following him stared at him in amazement as he wasted materials. At first they felt sorry for him, but by the end they were completely numb. The onlookers had even begun to guess whether this guy was a rich man who had come to the game to vent his anger due to some stimulation in reality.
After successfully upgrading five skills to master level, Lin Li finally stopped to take a breath. Just when everyone thought he was going to stop, Lin Li took out the wish scroll from his backpack.
"What does this guy want to do?" The power of the wish scroll is too terrifying. As soon as Lin Li took it out, several players behind him were on guard as if facing a formidable enemy. After all, this guy didn't look like a normal person, and he was holding a perverted thing like the wish scroll in his hand. If he couldn't think about it and made a wish for the system's main god to cause a massacre, wouldn't he be asking for death standing here?
"You really think highly of yourselves..." Lin Li glanced at the players who were facing formidable enemies, thinking that I would only use the wishing scroll to deal with you when I was full, and I didn't even weigh myself. Are you worth the price?
As the wishing scroll was gently unfolded, a rainbow suddenly hung in the sky above Mingyue City. The colorful light softly shone down, making the entire Mingyue City look as if it was enveloped in a dream. Amidst the solemn and sacred chants, a majestic voice came, as if it was far away in the sky, but it seemed as if it was close by.
"What is your wish?"
Lin Li looked at the rainbow in the sky, hesitated slightly, and then took a deep breath: "My wish is to improve all my life skills!"
At the moment when the wish was made, the rainbow in the sky turned into countless lights. The stars of light slowly fell from the sky, wrapping Lin Li like a seven-color ribbon. Lin Li could clearly feel that with every breath he took, countless lights seemed to be integrated into his body. When the last trace of light was completely absorbed, Endless knowledge poured out of his mind, including blacksmithing, alchemy, pharmacy, enchantment and inscription, and even miscellaneous knowledge about medicines, minerals, etc. It was as if he was born with this knowledge. As soon as it came out, it was integrated with his original memory. Lin Li could easily use it just by picking it up.
Lin Li checked his skill status. As expected, the four main skills have reached the master level, and most of the miscellaneous skills are above the master level. Considering that Endless World has been open for more than a year, it may be difficult to find a single-series master, let alone a five-series master.
Life skills are not comparable to personal level. As long as you have enough time, keep killing monsters, and keep completing tasks, you can accumulate enough experience to upgrade the personal level. But after reaching advanced life skills, it is really difficult to go further. Only a wealthy character like Lin Li can think of a way to use high-end materials to improve skills. Think about it, the five skills today cost almost five million gold coins. Except Lin Li, who just swept the dragon's lair, who can afford it?
The master level is more like a watershed. When skills reach the master level, it is no longer a problem that can be solved with money. Maybe ten thousand successful forgings will not improve your skills even a little bit, but one failed forging may make your skills improve by leaps and bounds. No one dares to say that one day he will definitely be able to.Reaching the Grandmaster level, even if he is only one step away from being a Grandmaster.
Of course, correspondingly, compared with the master, the master is in the sky and on the earth.
Master-level skills can only create legendary items at most, and they may not succeed even once in a thousand times, while grandmaster-level skills can not only create legendary items at will, but also easily create epic items. Although there is still a certain chance of failure, compared to master-level skills, it is simply different.
As for mythical items, that is beyond the imagination of ordinary people. People who can make artifacts, no matter what profession they are, will always have only one title, and that is - Divine Craftsman!
The Wish Scroll is a good thing. Using it to gain tens of millions of wealth, or to kill a mythical creature, or even to build your own kingdom is undoubtedly a good choice, but Lin Li always feels that using it to become a full-professional master is the wisest choice.
Lin Li glanced at the rainbow dissipating in the sky, and slowly put the remaining materials for training skills into his backpack. After witnessing the miracle, the dozens of onlookers had long since given up the idea of ​​killing people and stealing goods. They looked at Lin Li packing the materials with dull faces, but no one dared to move.
How could they afford to offend a person who could easily take out countless top-quality materials and smash out millions of gold coins with a hammer and a shake of a medicine bottle? Not to mention anything else, just take out hundreds of thousands of gold coins and hire people to kill them until their accounts are deleted. Killing people and stealing goods? It's almost suicide...
Putting all the materials into his backpack, Lin Lizhi was about to log off and change his account, and use the hunter to talk to the crowd, when a sharp alarm suddenly sounded.
"An unknown fault has occurred in the system. All online players are requested to log off immediately!"
"An unknown fault has occurred in the system. All online players are requested to log off immediately!"
"An unknown fault has occurred in the system. All online players are requested to log off immediately!"
The alarm sounded three times in a row. Just as Lin Li was about to get off the line, he suddenly realized that his character was no longer under control.
Before he could understand what was going on, this uncontrollable feeling had spread to his body in reality. It was as if his soul had been separated from his body. He could clearly see himself, but he could not feel his existence. Everything around him seemed to have become soft. No matter how hard Lin Li struggled, he could not get rid of that despairing feeling of powerlessness.
Lin Li gradually felt that a wisp of his consciousness was floating upwards. He could even see his other self lying softly on the chair. Lin Li suddenly raised his head in shock, and there was pitch black above his head. It was real darkness, without any impurities mixed in it. Even if there was a ray of light, he would be drawn into the endless darkness without any depth...
"Who is so nasty that he actually hid a black hole in my house!" Before the last trace of consciousness was swallowed up by the darkness, this was the question that popped up in Lin Li's mind...
